name: Disable Print Spooler
description: Disables the Print Spooler service to reduce background activity on systems where printing is not required.

description_i18n.en: Disables the Print Spooler service to reduce background activity on systems where printing is not required.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert den Druckspoolerdienst, um Hintergrundprozesse auf Systemen zu reduzieren, bei denen kein Drucken benötigt wird.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive le service d'exploitation des imprimantes pour réduire l'activité en arrière-plan sur les systèmes où l'impression n'est pas requise.

warnings.title: Printing functionality affected
warnings.message: Applications relying on system printing may fail or show errors until the service is re-enabled

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: The tweak sets the Spooler service startup type to Disabled and stops it if running This prevents Windows from automatically starting print processing services
